title: Oscar and the Postcard
author: Wendell Whitlock
blurb: Mara Halloran, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
